name: zvehicle_select_zrd_by_difficulty
description: zVehicle::SelectZrdByDifficulty selects a difficulty-specific vehicle ZRD when it can be resolved, otherwise falling back to vehicle.zrd.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Player/vehicle mission-load source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41fe50 validates fastcall ECX=extraSearchPath, zOpt::GetGameDifficultyMode, selecting vehicle_easy.zrd for difficulty 0, vehicle_hard.zrd for difficulty 2, vehicle.zrd otherwise, probing the selected filename through zReader::TryResolvePath, and returning vehicle.zrd when the selected filename cannot be resolved.
The native smoke verifies easy selection through an extra search path, hard fallback when vehicle_hard.zrd is missing, hard selection when present, and default difficulty selection.
